missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Граница' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'проходит'. 'Вдоль реки' uses the genitive to show along what it runs.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Границу' is the accusative direct object of 'охраняют'. 'Государственную' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'солдаты' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Границы' is the genitive after 'от' in the phrase 'недалеко от', not far from. 'Мы живём' states the location of dwelling.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На границе' uses the prepositional form 'границе' after 'на' to locate the car. 'Машина' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Границе' is the dative after 'к' showing approach toward the border. 'Поезд' is the nominative subject, and 'приближается' is the verb.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after за. 'Границей' is the instrumental after 'за' in the idiom 'за границей', abroad. 'Много интересного' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Границу' is the accusative after 'за' in the idiom 'за границу', going abroad. 'Летом' is the instrumental of time.
Strategic focus: Genitive after из-за. 'Границы' is the genitive after 'из-за' in the idiom 'из-за границы', from abroad. 'Туристы' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after несколько. 'Границ' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. 'Сухопутных' agrees in the plural, and 'у страны' is the genitive possessor.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Границы' is the nominative plural and the subject of 'проходят'. 'Между странами' uses the instrumental plural to show between what they lie.
